figurative_meaning_en: An indefinite time in the past
example_sentences_in_bangla: একসময় এই শহরে অনেক সবুজ ছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: Once upon a time, this city was full of greenery.
Back in the day, we all lived together.
history: একসময় সুন্দরবন অঞ্চলে জনপদ ছিল। (Once, there were settlements in the Sundarbans area.)
note: This phrase is often used to introduce folktales or historical anecdotes in Bengali literature and oral traditions.
